name: BibloRed
body: Two-year HSTS marked for preload, nosniff, framing limited to its origin, and a canonical. But http://www.biblored.gov.co/ serves the page with a 200 instead of redirecting, and browsers ignore HSTS sent over http.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with a 301. HSTS only counts when it arrives over https.
summary: www.biblored.gov.co scores 73 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 80 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 80 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /LeoRadio, /BibloRed-Podcast, /nosotros and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 200. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: 90 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Universal Analytics code is still on the page
fix.evidence: Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in July 2024. The code adds weight and collects nothing.
fix.fix: Remove the UA- tag and keep GA4.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 229 ms
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
